name: Kinetic stack
what: One bold word stacked; the middle copy comes in stretched and skewed like rubber, snaps into a clean stack, wobbles once and stretches away.

learned_from.what: the rubber settle (S-curve, ~33 f at 25 fps), the tilt, the stretched middle copy

motion: in 40 f (S-curve), hold breathing, a wobble 8 + 14 f, out 14 f
